Code checks are clean. The branch conflicts with main. Label: `conflicts`.

## Scope and results

This is a safety-tier review. I read the whole diff and issue #3333, including its comments. There is no earlier review.

- The orbit keeps its radius and circle vertices. Vector picks change the order of the existing directions.
- The generators keep the wear and allowance checks. The tests cover command refusals, generator refusals, stock simulation, MCP, undo and redo.
- The body has before/after screenshots for all three UI cases. I opened all six images.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, process file, importer or test fixture changed.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3980`. No GitHub runner ran.

The trial merge used upstream main `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`. It failed in the two files below. I aborted it without a resolution. All build and test results below apply to PR head `c2f1d36cdbd3e73da4327508cc9fe8e071e194a7`, not to a merged head. No merge commit exists, so the `HEAD^1` check does not apply.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 60 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Tests: 2,933 passed, 37 ignored. The gate selects the PR diff from merge base `97a676e5c`.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. All 11 light tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Both application and UI build steps (`--no-run`) passed. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs:69`: this file conflicts with current main. Refresh the branch and retain both families' pick behavior.
2. `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:398`: the `edit_operation` schema text conflicts with current main. Refresh the text for both families.

Run the targeted checks on the refreshed head. These are merge conflicts; I found no separate code blocker on the reviewed head. The PR stays a draft while it conflicts.

## Mutations rerun by the reviewer

Each mutation ran alone. I restored the original source after each run.

| Mutation in `sinker_picks.rs` | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Disable the `orbit.is_none()` refusal | `sinker_picks_orbit_ends_reads_angles_and_refuses_by_name` | Expected red: exit 101; the no-orbit pick was accepted |
| Remove the middle-of-move refusal | `sinker_picks_side_ends_choose_the_nearer_end_and_refuse_the_middle` | Expected red: exit 101; the middle pick was accepted |
| Restore the original source | All seven `sinker_picks::tests::` tests | Green: 7 passed |

The worktree has no source changes after these checks.

## Extra suites run

The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- Sinker golden suites: `sinker_burn`, `sinker_orbit`, `sinker_side`, `sinker_wear`, and `sinker_undersize`. All passed.
- `start_exit_shared`: 13 passed, including all nine new sinker tests.

No fixture or importer change triggers the extra kernel suites.

## Goldens moved

None. The PR diff changes no recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, or `examples/catalog` file. There are no moved golden lines to inspect. All selected sinker goldens passed without an update.

## Limits

The merged head could not be built because of the conflicts. Full heavy lanes did not run, as current main's review law specifies for this P2 PR. A real EDM control did not run these paths. No test failed on the unmodified PR head, so no bare-main failure comparison was needed.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No code, screenshot, log or other evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- `operation/pick_kinds.rs`: the local merge retains the sinker refusal arms and the wire exit refusal arm. Pins: `sinker::side::mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_sinker_picks_and_refuses_an_impossible_one_by_name` and `edit_operation_sets_the_wire_exit_pick_and_refuses_one_it_cannot_hold`. Each arm removal made its pin fail.
- `mcp/tools.rs`: the local schema retains both families' pick descriptions. Pin: `the_mcp_doors_name_the_pick_fields_and_the_kinds_that_take_them`. Removing either family's description made the pin fail.

After restore, `start_exit_shared` passed 13 tests. `mcp_wire_contour` passed 9 tests.

Held local merge tested: `a9bc76c8a3db5b3d1c13787171819eaec61233e9`. It was not pushed. The remote head remains `c2f1d36cdbd3e73da4327508cc9fe8e071e194a7`.

Quick gate: GREEN. 61 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Tests: 2,957 passed, 37 ignored. Catalog and reached sinker golden suites passed. No recorded program changed.

The first quick run had missing dependency artifacts (`E0463`). A local clean of affected packages resolved it. The successful run used `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_SWEEP=off CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=16`.

Heavy gate: RED. 108 steps, 1 unexpected failure, 0 stalled; 37.9 min. The four configured known-fail probes were red as expected and counted as OK. Heavy catalog: 4 passed.

The unexpected failure was `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:80`. The test expected a mesh with 6,228 triangles and got 5,232. No extra code fix is permitted in this review round.

Clippy: GREEN for motion, app and UI, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`; 36.68 s.

The fixes remain local in `.claude/worktrees/fix-3980`. The warm worktree is retained.

Please re-review the conflict resolutions and the pin extension after the blocker is cleared and the fix is pushed.

Addressed: merge-time refresh. The only blocker was the conflict with `main`.

Class: DELTA. I merged `upstream/main` into the branch with a merge commit. There is no rebase and no force-push. I resolved three hunks by hand. Each hunk keeps the two sides:

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (`s_edit_op`): the text keeps main's lathe list (#3331, Meridian kinds) and the Wire Contour start/exit text from main (#3332). The Sinker Burn and Sinker Side Burn pick text from this PR is added after the Wire Contour text.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs` (`sane` tail): this is one `match`. It keeps `OpParams::WireContour(w) => wire_exit_refusal(w)` (#3332) and adds the `SinkerBurn` `orbit_ends()` and `SinkerSideBurn` `side_ends()` refusals (#3333). No refusal is lost. In `pick()`, git merged the arms itself: Contour5D Ring (#3330), Meridian turning kinds and Threading (#3331), Slot Ends (#3325), RotaryFlow owed (#2826), and SinkerBurn Ring / SinkerSideBurn Ends (#3333).
3. `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`: the file keeps the #3330 and #3331 gate-map lines and adds the #3333 gate-map line and `mod sinker`. The capability test keeps the Meridian and Slot arms and adds the two sinker arms.

`git show --remerge-diff HEAD` shows only these three files.

Pins run on the new head:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test start_exit_shared` (this PR's `sinker` / `sinker_side` modules, with the #3330 `contour5d` and #3331 `turning` pins): 24 passed.
- Sibling pins: `slot_start_exit` (#3325) 10 passed; `wire_dxf_selection` 10 passed and `wire_post` 18 passed, which include the #3332 `exit_pick` modules; `mcp_wire_contour` 9 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 62 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes the ui lib (`sinker_pick_rows_tests`) and the sinker app suites.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib sinker_picks`: 7 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

New head: ae4d444e8b2b17bb1550bea86596ea40f2ae4be1

Please do a delta review of the remerge-diff.

2. `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:399`: fixed by the same commit. The schema retains the wire start/exit text, the lathe list, and both sinker descriptions.

I read the author's [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3980#issuecomment-7168989853). I checked all three files in the remerge diff and the complete PR diff. The trial merge is `236650e18d4547b034b558cb0c37af9fc8c358e1`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. Its second parent is upstream main `3bb6647f62cb55b8d0b6342afcd9bd18ae4a59de`. The merge was clean. I used that main's `AGENTS.md` as the review law.
